summary: Read surface for cards including get, list with filters, full-text search, tree, context, and relation graph.

context.problem:
Cards are read in many shapes: by exact key, by filter (type, status, tag, glossary, symbol),
by free text, by parent-child tree, by neighborhood context, and as a relation graph. Without
a unified read surface every caller would re-implement joins and pagination, drifting from a
single source of truth.

impact.statement: Inconsistent read surfaces produce subtly different results across the CLI, causing user confusion.
Search performance degrades quickly without an explicit index strategy.

goals.statement: Provide getCard, listCards, searchCards, getCardTree, getCardContext, listCardRelations, getRelationGraph as the only read entry points.
Filters compose orthogonally so combined filters return the intersection.
Search rejects malformed queries with a clear error.

assumptions.statement: Full-text search uses the SQLite FTS5 extension.
assumptions.verification: Check schema.ts for fts5 table declaration.
assumptions.reevaluate_when: A platform without FTS5 must be supported.

flow.given: A list call with type=brief and status=active.
flow.then: A paginated list of brief active cards is returned with has_more flag.

flow.given: A search call with a valid FTS query string.
flow.then: A ranked list of matching cards is returned.

flow.given: A search call with malformed FTS syntax.
flow.then: An FtsSyntaxError is thrown with exit code 2.

design.overview:
Each read returns a typed result shape. listCards composes WHERE clauses from independent
filter inputs. searchCards delegates to FTS5 with explicit syntax validation up front.
getCardTree and getCardContext recurse through parent and relation tables with a configurable
depth ceiling (default 3 per project decisions).

components.name: listCards
components.responsibility: Filtered list with composable predicates and pagination.

components.name: searchCards
components.responsibility: FTS5-backed search with explicit syntax check.

components.name: getCardContext
components.responsibility: Neighborhood traversal (parent BFS plus relations) capped at depth.

components.name: getRelationGraph
components.responsibility: Forward and reverse relations for a card.

invariants.statement: Filter composition is intersection (AND), never union.
Tree and context traversals respect a depth ceiling to bound work.

policy.subject: searchCards
policy.predicate: validate FTS syntax before query execution and throw FtsSyntaxError on failure.

policy.subject: listCards filter composition
policy.predicate: behave as conjunction across orthogonal filters.

external.statement: BFS depth ceiling default of 3 follows the project roadmap decision.

guarantees.subject: Read entry points public signatures
guarantees.breaks_if: A required filter is added without a default.

limits.statement: searchCards relevance ranking depends on FTS5 default tokenizer; locale-specific tokenization is not configured.
getRelationGraph returns one hop only; multi-hop is the responsibility of getCardContext.

measure.predicate: Combined type and status filters return intersection.
measure.method: Integration test that asserts filter composition behavior.

measure.predicate: Malformed FTS query exits 2 with FtsSyntaxError.
measure.method: CLI-level test invoking ed card search with a broken query.

cons: Result type cannot be tightened per use case
forcing every caller to handle a union.

chosen.option: Narrow read entry points backed by SQLite plus FTS5.
chosen.reasoning: Matches single-user CLI deployment, keeps result shapes precise per use case.
